A '''T'surr''' served as a [[Daimanate Sith trooper]] on [[Chelloa]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. During the [[Raid on Chelloa]], he was about to kill undercover [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Chelloan resistance]] leader [[Gorlan Palladane]] and several other slave workers when he was knocked unconscious by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] who sliced his crowbar in mace in half. His companion was a [[Unidentified human Daimanate Sith trooper|bald human officer]] who was also incapacitated by Gorlan himself.

He survived the battle and was present during [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s interrogation of Gorlan. He held a bound Gorlan while the latter was punched and kicked by Daiman who had discovered the agent who had leaked intelligence about his [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] operations to the Jedi and his rival Lord [[Odion]].
